title: Everyone Ai
one_liner: Self-service AI workspace platform for launching Claude Code environments via Kubernetes.
what_it_is: A portal that allows team members to launch isolated VS Code workspaces backed by Claude Code in seconds. It manages the lifecycle of these workspaces on a k3s cluster, providing an app catalog, usage monitoring, and persistent HTTPS endpoints for deployed apps without requiring local machine configuration.
how_its_built: Built with Node.js and Express for the backend API, vanilla JavaScript for the frontend SPA, and Helm charts for Kubernetes deployment. It uses k3s as the underlying cluster engine, Traefik for ingress routing, and code-server for browser-based VS Code instances. The CLI tool 'afterburner' automates cluster bootstrapping and installation.
how_to_apply: Operators use the 'afterburner' CLI to bootstrap a Linux VM into a k3s cluster and deploy the portal via Helm. End users connect via VPN, access the web portal, select a template from the App Catalog, and launch a workspace which provides a direct link to a browser-based VS Code instance with Claude Code pre-configured.
quickstart:
npx afterburner bootstrap --host <ip> --ssh-key ~/.ssh/id_rsa
npx afterburner install
helm install everyone-ai-portal ./charts/portal -f profiles/k3s.yaml -f config.yaml --namespace myteam --create-namespace
open https://portal.<your-domain>
features: Launch Claude Code workspaces in under 30 seconds via web portal
App Catalog with pre-configured templates for Python, Node.js, and HR agents
Automated k3s cluster bootstrapping and Helm deployment via afterburner CLI
Browser-based VS Code environments with no local setup required
Team-wide usage monitoring and fleet overview across multiple portals
Persistent HTTPS endpoints for deploying apps from workspaces
